test_read_orc_file: test reading an ORC file with read_orc and verifying the returned DataFrame matches expected data
test_write_orc_roundtrip_file: test writing a DataFrame to ORC via to_orc and reading it back to verify roundtrip fidelity
test_write_orc_roundtrip_bytesio: test writing a DataFrame to ORC in memory via BytesIO and reading it back without writing to disk
test_orc_dtype_backend_pyarrow: test reading an ORC file with dtype_backend='pyarrow' to use ArrowExtensionArray for all columns
test_orc_dtype_backend_numpy_nullable: test reading an ORC file with dtype_backend='numpy_nullable' to use pandas nullable dtypes
